metadata.title: Crypto mixers: laundering rails vs financial-privacy tools

notes: Ported from bubble-map privacy-tool + crypto-crime threads. The genuine dual-use: the same mixers that give ordinary users on-chain privacy are the laundering rail for state and criminal theft. Sanction-and-prosecution outcomes are graded; the Tornado Cash OFAC designation was later vacated - present both.

entities.name: Tornado_Cash
entities.notes: Ethereum coin-mixing smart contracts. OFAC sanctioned it (Aug 2022), citing >$7B laundered incl. Lazarus proceeds. Nov 2024 the 5th Circuit ruled OFAC overstepped (immutable smart contracts aren't sanctionable 'property'); Treasury delisted it (Mar 2025). Co-founder Roman Storm convicted on one count (Aug 2025).

entities.name: Samourai_Wallet
entities.notes: Bitcoin privacy wallet (Whirlpool coinjoin, Ricochet). DOJ/SDNY charged its founders (Apr 2024) with money-laundering/unlicensed-money-transmission; FinCEN framing contested by privacy advocates.

entities.name: Roman_Storm
entities.notes: Tornado Cash co-founder. Convicted Aug 2025 on one count (operating an unlicensed money-transmitting business); jury hung on the money-laundering/sanctions counts. The 'is writing code a crime' test case.

entities.name: OFAC
entities.notes: Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control. Runs the SDN sanctions list; its Tornado Cash designation was the first against autonomous smart-contract code - and the first to be judicially vacated.

entities.name: FinCEN
entities.notes: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network. Money-transmitter registration/AML regime under which mixer operators are charged.

entities.name: Financial_Privacy
entities.notes: The legitimate demand the mixers also serve: on-chain pseudonymity is not anonymity, and public ledgers expose everyone's balances/history. The privacy case that makes mixers dual-use rather than purely criminal.

edges.notes: 5th Circuit: immutable smart contracts not 'property'; Treasury delisted Mar 2025.

edges.instrument: OFAC designation judicially vacated; code persists on-chain
edges.notes: The protocol (immutable contracts) outlived the sanction; the people did not.
